args.reason: The old decision forbids writing secrets to `.faff/`. Caching resolved API keys in `.faff/cache/credentials.json` writes literal secrets there, so it breaks the guardrail rather than superseding it on new facts. Being gitignored only stops the file reaching the repo; the key still sits in plaintext on disk where logs, backups, sandbox mounts and other tools can read it. The stated benefit is weak: reading `process.env` is an in-memory lookup, and an in-process cache would give the same speed-up without touching disk. The argument does not show the old rationale no longer holds.
